args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18 since its latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback completed successfully; monitoring for recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failure and the rollback action.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows v2.3.0 healthy in all regions with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was required — the rollback was to a previously healthy production release.
